title: Complete virtual unwrapping and reading of a rolled Herculaneum papyrus
abstract: arXiv:2606.29085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The carbonized papyrus scrolls from Herculaneum preserve the only large-scale library to survive from classical antiquity. Many scrolls have remained unread because physical unrolling risks irreversible damage. Non-invasive imaging offers a route to their texts, yet previous work on sealed Herculaneum scrolls has recovered only localized readings. Here, by combining high-resolution X-ray computed microtomography ($\mu$CT) data acquired on the BM18 beamline at the ESRF with machine-learning-assisted virtual unwrapping, we study three still-closed scrolls. For PHerc. 1667, a remnant of earlier attempts at physical unrolling, we achieve the complete unwrapping and reading of the preserved writing surface, making it the first Herculaneum papyrus read completely by virtual unwrapping. translated_title: 赫库兰尼姆卷轴纸草文献的完整虚拟展开与解读
translated_abstract: 来自赫库兰尼姆的碳化纸草卷轴保存了古典时代唯一幸存下来的大规模图书馆。许多卷轴至今仍未被阅读，因为物理展开存在造成不可逆损坏的风险。非侵入式成像为读取其中的文本提供了一条途径，但此前对密封的赫库兰尼姆卷轴的研究仅恢复出局部文字。在本研究中，我们将欧洲同步辐射光源（ESRF）BM18光束线上获取的高分辨率X射线显微计算机断层扫描（μCT）数据与机器学习辅助的虚拟展开技术相结合，研究了三卷仍未开封的卷轴。对于PHerc. 1667——早期物理展开尝试后留下的残卷——我们实现了对所保存书写表面的完整展开与解读，使其成为首个通过虚拟展开被完整阅读的赫库兰尼姆纸草文献。该文本由九位纸草学家进行了转录并交叉验证。在PHerc. Paris. 4——2023年维苏威挑战赛大奖文本的来源卷轴——
tldr: 研究团队将高分辨率X射线显微CT与机器学习辅助的虚拟展开技术相结合，首次实现了对赫库兰尼姆碳化纸草卷轴PHerc. 1667全部书写表面的完整展开与解读，这是史上第一卷被完整虚拟阅读的赫库兰尼姆纸草文献。
en_tdlr: By combining high-resolution X-ray microtomography with machine-learning-assisted virtual unwrapping, researchers achieved the complete unwrapping and reading of Herculaneum papyrus PHerc. 1667, making it the first Herculaneum scroll fully read through virtual unwrapping.
